scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix client run start"
scripts.setup: npm --prefix client install && cd server && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -e .
